event: Born Aug 29, 1958, in Gary, Indiana; father Joseph a crane operator
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson; CBS News/AP 2018 - Joe Jackson's complicated relationship with his children

event: Early 1960s (exact year not in sources): Joseph forms his sons into a group and has them rehearse five hours a day after school; Michael later described beatings with a switch; Joseph said he whipped him with a stick and a belt but never beat him
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson; NPR 2018 - Joe Jackson obituary; CBS News/AP 2018

event: Group wins an amateur contest at the Apollo Theater in New York (NPR dates it 1967, when Michael was 9)
source: NPR 2018 - Joe Jackson obituary; Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5

event: Motown audition in Detroit, July 1968
source: Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5

event: Signs with Motown Mar 11, 1969; brothers relocated to Los Angeles
source: Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5

event: First Motown single, I Want You Back, released Oct 7, 1969
source: uDiscover Music - I Want You Back: The Jackson 5's Sensational Motown Debut

event: I Want You Back hits #1 on Billboard Hot 100, Jan 31, 1970; childhood becomes full-time work
source: Motown Classic - Jackson 5 I Want You Back; uDiscover Music - I Want You Back

event: Debut solo album Got to Be There at 13, while still singing lead in the group
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: First solo No. 1 single, Ben
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Group announces in 1975 it is leaving Motown and signs with Epic on Mar 10, 1976; Jermaine stays at Motown; Joseph helped steer the exit
source: Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5; AP 2018 via WTOP - Joe Jackson turned his children into stars, but at a price

event: The Wiz (1978): plays the Scarecrow and meets Quincy Jones on set
source: TIME 2015 - Behind the Scenes of The Wiz With Michael Jackson; Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Off the Wall released Aug 10, 1979 - first real creative-control push
source: AllMusic - Off the Wall (prior session; not re-fetched, 403); Biography.com - Michael Jackson; Rock & Roll Hall of Fame - Michael Jackson

event: Thriller released Nov 30, 1982; Guinness lists it as the best-selling album of all time (67 million units)
source: Guinness World Records - Best-selling album

event: Debuts the moonwalk performing Billie Jean on a 1983 TV special honoring Motown
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Scalp burned filming Pepsi commercial, Jan 27, 1984; widely reported as start of painkiller use
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson iconic moments (prior session); Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Guinness confirms Thriller as the world's best-selling album (Feb 1984); seven trophies at the 1984 Grammy Awards
source: Guinness World Records 2015 - 1984: Best-Selling Album of All Time

event: Autobiography Moonwalk: 'still I don't know him, and that's sad for a son who hungers to understand his own father'; buys 2,700 acres in Los Olivos, California, for $17 million
source: CBS News/AP 2018 (quotes Moonwalk); Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Oprah interview, Feb 10, 1993: describes crying from loneliness, fear of his father, getting sick when he saw him
source: Oprah.com - Oprah Reflects on Her Interview with Michael Jackson (prior session; not re-fetched, 403); NPR 2018; CBS News/AP 2018

event: Tells Oprah the change in his skin tone comes from the skin condition vitiligo
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson

event: Dies June 25, 2009, at 50 after cardiac arrest at his Los Angeles home; coroner rules acute propofol intoxication, manner homicide (Aug 28, 2009); his physician convicted of involuntary manslaughter (Nov 7, 2011)
source: Biography.com - Michael Jackson; ABC News 2009 - death ruled a homicide; ABA Journal 2011 - Conrad Murray guilty
